content:
A completed weekend installation where visitors left short voice notes about
places they cared for. Sofia hosted the garden and Leo assembled a gentle
soundscape from opt-in recordings.

## What carried forward

The project proved that a contribution can be meaningful without being long.
That lesson now shapes the [Neighborhood Atlas](/note/projects/neighborhood_atlas/neighborhood_atlas)
and the proposed [Mobile Story Booth](/note/projects/mobile_story_booth/mobile_story_booth).

occurrences.context: Recordings from the completed Listening Garden inspired the audio direction for the proposed Mobile Story Booth.
Sofia hosted the Listening Garden and now advises the Atlas team on welcoming event formats.

- People: Alex, Amara, and the full People section - Projects: active, planned, completed, and idea - Tasks: todo, in progress, blocked, and done records with subtasks and deadlines - Calendar: social and work events, a weekly series, project links, and a cross-midnight event
Sofia's completed Listening Garden offers another example of a temporary third place.
The earlier Listening Garden is complete, and the Mobile Story Booth is waiting for its next planning window.
The plan borrows the welcoming format of the Listening Garden and the consent model from the Neighborhood Atlas.
